department: Department of Chemistry and Chemical Biology

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 at 5:00 pm (US Eastern).

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is required.

supervisor.value: First-year students do lab rotations and must join a research group by June 30 of the first year.
supervisor.quote: Incoming graduate students are required to participate in three four-week rotations in different laboratories | Students are required to enter a research group by June 30 of their first year.

funding.value: All Harvard Griffin GSAS PhD students get guaranteed funding for the first five years.
funding.quote: Our financial aid program features guaranteed funding for the first five years to all PhD students

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's degree; for international applicants a three- or four-year undergraduate degree from a recognized institution is accepted.
entry_route.quote: welcomes applications for admission from individuals who have or will have by the time of matriculation a BA, BS, or equivalent undergraduate degree (for prospective international students, a three- or four-year undergraduate degree from an institution of recognized standing)

notes: Part of Harvard Integrated Life Sciences. Covers the PhD in chemistry and, via the Committee on Chemical Physics, chemical physics. Zoom interviews in late December/early January; personal statement and resume required.
